entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, this is Alex speaking. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for an order. It's for the VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yeah, hold on. It's VF789-012. I got it about two, maybe three weeks ago. Just haven't had a chance to deal with it.
Okay, pulling that up now... VF789-012. I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered 18 days ago. No problem at all.
So am I still able to return it?
Oh, absolutely. **Don't worry**, our **standard policy** gives you **90 days** from the delivery date to make a return. You have **plenty of time**.
Oh, 90 days? Okay, good. I was worried I might have missed the window. How do I get the label?
I can generate that and email it directly to you. Just give me one moment here while I process the request in the system... hmm.
Is there a problem?
It's a little strange. The system is giving me an error message and won't let me create the return authorization. Let me just check the item's policy notes.
You just said I had 90 days. What's going on?

Sir, I am so sorry. I seem to have made a mistake. There's a specific exception for the VeloBand Pulse. Because it's an electronic wearable, it has a strict 10-day return window. I was quoting our standard policy for apparel and other gear. I sincerely apologize for the misinformation.
Are you serious?! You literally just told me not to worry and that I had 'plenty of time'! I would have sent this back last week if I knew it was only 10 days. That's completely unacceptable.
I completely understand your frustration, and you are right to be upset. It was my error, and I take full responsibility for giving you the incorrect information.
So what does that mean? I'm stuck with a $150 device I don't want because you read your policy wrong?

No, we're going to make this right for you. While the system won't let me process a refund to your credit card because it's past the 10-day mark, I can issue a full VeloFit store credit for the value of the item, which is $149.99.
Store credit... I guess that's better than nothing, but this has been a huge waste of my time.

I agree. And for the inconvenience and my mistake, I'd also like to add an additional $25 credit to your account. You can use the full amount on any other VeloFit products. I can apply it to your account right now.
Wait, so the full amount for the band, plus another $25 on top of it?
Yes, that's correct. A total of about $175 in store credit, available for you to use immediately. It's the least we can do to make up for my error.
Wow. Okay. That... that actually works. I was looking at some new bib shorts anyway. Yes, please do that. Thank you.
Of course. I've just applied the credit to your VeloFit account. You should see it effective immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. I really appreciate you resolving this. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for your understanding and for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
